parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, typically circular and slightly domed to fit securely on the pot.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, helping to control temperature and prevent splattering.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not move independently when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape with handles on the sides.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds food and liquids for cooking, providing the main volume for heating and boiling.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during use, though it can be lifted or moved by its handles.
